home.meta_title: Convert documents on your own device
home.title: Convert documents on your own device
home.lede: AriadShift converts Markdown, HTML, Word, EPUB and structured JSON right here in your browser. Read digital PDF text and create PDFs on your device. One measured planner, no uploads.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: The converter runs inside your browser with WebAssembly. Your document is stored in the browser's private file system and never uploaded.

quality.title: Measured quality
quality.body: Every route carries fidelity and editability scores from a public benchmark. The planner picks the best one and tells you why.

agents.title: Ready for AI agents
agents.body: Turn documents into clean Markdown or structured JSON for LLM context. The CLI ships an MCP server, so agents can convert files themselves.

how.step_1: You pick a file. The browser copies it into its private file system.
how.step_2: A background worker loads the AriadShift engine compiled to WebAssembly.
how.step_3: The planner chooses the route with the best measured score for your goal.
how.step_4: You download the result. Starting over deletes every stored file.

home.see_more: See every <formats>supported format</formats> and the <quality>measured quality</quality> of each route.

privacy.meta_description: What the AriadShift website does with your documents: nothing leaves your device.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: The converter on this website runs entirely in your browser. This page explains what that means in practice.
privacy.documents_heading: Your documents stay on your device
privacy.documents_storage: When you choose a file, the browser copies it into its origin private file system, a storage area that only this website can read and that is not part of your regular files. The conversion runs in a background worker using WebAssembly. The file is never sent to a server, and the converted file is written to the same private storage, from which you download it. Each open tab keeps its files in its own folder there.
privacy.documents_memory: If your browser cannot provide that storage, the files are held in the worker's memory instead and disappear when you close the tab.
privacy.deleting_body: “Start over and delete files” removes the input and output from the private storage at once. Files of a tab you close without starting over stay in that storage until you next open the converter, which deletes them on start. Clearing this site's data in your browser settings removes them as well.
privacy.tracking_body: The website sets no cookies, loads no analytics or advertising scripts and makes no requests to other sites. A service worker caches the converter so it keeps working offline; it stores only the website's own code. Your theme choice is kept in local storage.
privacy.hosting_body: Like any website, the server that delivers these pages may keep standard access logs (IP address, time, requested URL). Those requests never include your documents.
